content:
**Gunther's Big Iron** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Nuka-World on Tour* update.

## Gameplay[edit]

The weapon is a Nuka-Cola-themed Single Action Revolver, modified to use .45 Rounds and a 45% increased reload speed. In addition, it comes with three legendary effects; Two Shot, Rapid and Swift.

## Location[edit]

Can only be obtained as a reward from completing the Event: Most Wanted.

## Behind the Scenes[edit]

The weapon is "A Nuka-Cola themed re-skin of the Single Action Revolver" created by Double Eleven artist Molly Entwistle. [Dev 1]
